title: Kore by Imtiaz
paymentPlan: 50/50 plan. Alternatively, a 60/40 post-handover plan with 40% paid over three years after handover and a 10% price increase. Confirm the applicable price and full instalment schedule for your chosen home.
summary: Studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments by Imtiaz Developments in Dubai Land Residence Complex, with planned fitness, leisure and shared work spaces.

children.text: Kore by Imtiaz is a planned wellness-focused apartment development in Dubai Land Residence Complex (DLRC), Dubai. The offering includes studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments, with target completion in Q4 2028.
Planned amenities include a 25-metre swimming pool, Technogym, a padel court, The Hike, red light therapy, a sauna, active co-working stations, an edible garden, green spaces and a club lounge.

The home-type schedule shows the starting sizes and prices supplied by Haus. These figures describe the development offering rather than individual available units. Ask Haus of Estate to confirm current availability, the exact size, the applicable price and payment terms for your chosen home.

keyFeatures: Studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments
Building configuration: basement, ground floor, three podiums, 13 residential floors and roof
